parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: SnapshotName
parameters.description:
The name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

The name cannot start with **auto** because snapshots whose names start with auto are recognized as automatic snapshots.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-snapshot-attribute --snapshot-id sp-bp199lyny9bb47pa0000 --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --description testDescription --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifySnapshotAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --SnapshotId 'sp-bp199lyny9bb47pa0000' --Description testDescription --SnapshotName testSnapshotName
